detail.active_state: This agency is active. Its users can sign in normally.
detail.suspended_state: This agency is suspended. All of its users are blocked from signing in.

suspend.title: Suspend {name}
suspend.description: Suspending this agency blocks ALL of its users from signing in. This is recorded in the audit log.
suspend.reason_hint: Required, at least {count} characters. Recorded in the audit log.
suspend.failed: We couldn't suspend this agency. Please try again.

reactivate.title: Reactivate {name}
reactivate.description: Reactivating this agency restores sign-in for all of its users. This is recorded in the audit log.
reactivate.failed: We couldn't reactivate this agency. Please try again.

members.heading: Members
members.boundary_note: Two-factor state is shown as a yes/no only. Administrators can never see a member's two-factor secret or recovery codes, generate codes for them, or set two-factor up on their behalf.
members.load_failed: We couldn't load this agency's members. Please refresh.

mfa_tooltip.also_enrolled: Still enrolled — they are asked for a code when they sign in.

errors.nothing_to_reset: This member has no two-factor enrollment to reset.
errors.platform_admin_not_exemptable: Platform administrators can never be exempted from two-factor authentication.

actions.reason_hint: Required, at least {count} characters. Recorded in the audit log.
actions.failed: We couldn't complete this action. Please try again.

reset.title: Reset two-factor for {name}
reset.description: This clears their authenticator app and recovery codes. They set two-factor up again the next time they reach a protected page, and they are emailed a security notice. The account still requires two-factor.
reset.success: Two-factor reset. The member has been emailed.

exempt.title: Exempt {name} from two-factor
exempt.description: This removes the requirement to set two-factor up — a security downgrade for this person. If they already have it set up it stays active and they are still asked for a code at sign-in. They are emailed, and your reason is recorded in the audit log.
exempt.success: Member exempted from two-factor. They have been emailed.

remove_exemption.title: Restore two-factor for {name}
remove_exemption.description: This restores the two-factor requirement. They are asked to set it up the next time they reach a protected page, if they haven't already. They are emailed, and your reason is recorded in the audit log.
remove_exemption.success: Two-factor requirement restored. The member has been emailed.
